title: Cafe purchases
hint: Record supplies bought from suppliers and review past purchases. Each purchase updates stock and the moving average cost.

form.title: Record a purchase
form.noSuppliersLink: Add one on the Cafe products page
form.noProducts: No active products yet; add products first.
form.noProductsLink: Add products on the Cafe products page
form.invalidQty: The quantity must be positive, with at most three decimals.
form.invalidUnitCost: The unit cost must be a whole number of Toman (0 or more).
form.needOneItem: At least one complete line is required.
form.duplicateProduct: Each product may appear once; merge duplicate lines.

list.title: Recorded purchases
list.truncated: Only the most recent purchases are shown; narrow the range or supplier to see more.
list.emptyDescription: Widen the range, or record the first purchase with the form above.
